title: Comparison of security mechanisms of Mathematical cipher, Wyner scheme, QKD, and Quantum stream cipher
summary: A new generation of global communications technology has been emerging. These systems, which utilize established device technologies and quantum effect devices, require ultra-high speeds, low cost, and strong security. In recent years, global communication systems have faced various practical security challenges depending on their configurations, and research efforts are underway to address these issues.
